ficha.privadoDica: The person chose not to show this count.

estado.dica: Changes right away and shows on your page. Carries no text.

selos.legenda: Each badge counts different friends who are still friends. Who gave it never shows.
selos.semPermissao: Only friends of 7 days or more, with an account of 7 days or more, can give a badge.
selos.semAmizade: Badges are between friends. Ask for friendship first.
selos.nenhumTexto: Badges arrive when real friends recognize what this rover is like.
selos.podeEm: You will be able to give badges from {data}, when your friendship and your account reach 7 days.

relacao.desfazerTexto: The badges {nome} gave stop counting. You can be friends again later with a new request.
relacao.bloquearTexto: You stop being friends and stop following each other, and nothing else passes between you. {nome} gets no notice at all.
relacao.silenciarTexto: You stop receiving alerts from {nome}. Nothing else changes, and {nome} isn't told.
relacao.bloqueadoTexto: What {nome} wrote on your wall disappears from here. You can still read the page.
relacao.denunciarNota: To report something on this page, use the menu of the wall message or testimonial.
relacao.semApp: To follow, add as a friend or leave a note, sign in with your Rovemark account.
relacao.nunca: The other side is never told.

mural.sub: Short notes left by whoever stopped by.
mural.placeholder: Hi, I stopped by to say...
mural.vazioTexto: Nobody has pinned a note on {nome}'s page yet.
mural.vazioProprio: Your wall is waiting for its first note. Friends can start the conversation.
mural.ninguem: This wall isn't taking messages right now.
mural.amigos: This wall takes messages from friends only.
mural.naoPode: This wall isn't taking a message from you right now.
mural.propriaPagina: On your wall, the others write. To talk to everyone, use a post.
mural.apagarTexto: It disappears from the wall. This can't be undone.
mural.removerTitulo: Take this message off your wall?
mural.removerTexto: It disappears from your page. The author gets a notice that it was removed, with the reason.

depoimentos.sub: Written by friends and published only after {nome} accepts.
depoimentos.subProprio: Written by friends. They show to others only after you accept.
depoimentos.pendentesTexto: Only you and the author can see these testimonials.
depoimentos.esconderTexto: It leaves your page. The author can only write another after 7 days.
depoimentos.recusarTexto: It shows up nowhere. The author can only write another after 7 days.
depoimentos.placeholder: The best part of an afternoon with {nome} is...
depoimentos.avisoAceite: The testimonial only shows after {nome} accepts it.
depoimentos.semAmizade: Testimonials are between friends. Ask for friendship first.
depoimentos.semTempo: Only friends of 3 days or more write testimonials, and the account must also be 3 days old.
depoimentos.naoPode: You can't write a testimonial here right now.
depoimentos.vazioTexto: When a friend writes and {nome} accepts, the letter shows up here.
depoimentos.vazioProprio: There are no accepted testimonials yet. The ones that arrive wait for your decision.
depoimentos.seuPendente: Your testimonial is waiting for acceptance
depoimentos.podeEm: You will be able to write a testimonial from {data}, when your friendship and your account reach 3 days.
depoimentos.enviadosTitulo: Written by you, waiting for approval
depoimentos.enviadosTexto: They only show to others once the page owner accepts. You and the owner are the only ones who see them.

amigos.emComumVazio: You don't have friends in common yet.
amigos.vazioTexto: {nome} has no friends who keep the list open yet.
amigos.privadoTexto: The person chose not to show this list. The rest of the page is still open.

grupos.privadoTexto: The person chose not to show which groups and pages they are in. The rest of the page is still open.

erro.naoAchoTexto: The @ may have changed, or the rover left the network. Try the search.

denunciar.intro: Tell us why this shouldn't be here. Community moderators and the relay moderators read every report.

spam: Repeated content or something that only wants attention.
assedio: Attack, stalking or disrespect toward someone.
ilegal: Something the law forbids or that puts someone at risk.
dados-pessoais: Someone's name, contact, document or address.
golpe: Tries to trick people out of money, access or data.
menores: Something that puts a minor at risk.
fora-do-tema: Has nothing to do with where it was posted.
personificacao: Pretends to be someone or a brand
Uses a name or identity that isn't the writer's.

denunciar.anonima: Your report is anonymous. Not the author, not whoever moderates the place, not other rovers know it was you. This site creates no cookie or identifier of yours for it.
denunciar.semPeso: A report never deletes anything by itself: it only joins a queue, and a person with a role decides.
denunciar.recebidaTexto: Thanks for letting us know. You don't need to do anything else.
denunciar.semApp: To report without the Rover Hangar app, use the Report page: no account needed.

socAmigos.sub: Who walks with your rover and who asked to.
socAmigos.semApp: This page belongs to your rover. Pair the Rover Hangar app with this browser to see your friends.
socAmigos.enviadosVazio: You have no request waiting for an answer.
socAmigos.meusAmigosVazioTexto: Ask whoever you meet on the network. A friend opens the door to wall messages, testimonials and badges.
socAmigos.relacoesSub: The other side is never told. Only you see this list.

socAvisos.sub: What happened near your rover. Alerts carry no text: open what interests you.
socAvisos.semApp: Alerts belong to your rover. Pair the Rover Hangar app with this browser to see them.
socAvisos.vazioTexto: When someone leaves a wall message, asks to be friends or replies to a topic of yours, the alert shows up here.

tipos.recado: {nome} left a message on your wall
tipos.depoimento-para-aceitar: {nome} wrote a testimonial for you to accept
tipos.selo-recebido: A friend gave your rover a badge
tipos.removido-por-responsavel: Whoever looks after the space removed something your rover wrote
tipos.expulso: You left {lugar} by a moderator's decision
tipos.resolveu: {nome} marked your reply as the one that solved it in {topico}
tipos.conversa-pedido: {nome} asked to talk with you by private message
tipos.conversa-aceita: {nome} agreed to talk with you by private message

removidos.sub: What the people who look after a space hid from what your rover wrote. Only you see this list.
removidos.vazio: Nothing from your rover was removed.
removidos.trecho: The text the relay still keeps
removidos.semTrecho: The relay no longer keeps the removed text.

apelacao.aberta: Appeal open, waiting for a decision
apelacao.revertida: Appeal accepted: the content is back

removidos.semApelo: This removal cannot be appealed from here.
